annotation.title_clean: State of the Digital Decade 2026: Closing structural gaps and mobilising investments for 2030 and beyond
annotation.title_en: State of the Digital Decade 2026: Closing structural gaps and mobilising investments for 2030 and beyond
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Communication assessing progress toward the EU's 2030 Digital Decade targets. It identifies structural gaps in technology sovereignty, cybersecurity, adoption and skills, and calls for scaled-up investment and revised national roadmaps by December 2026. AI is treated as general infrastructure and policy; robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States must update national Digital Decade roadmaps by December 2026 responding to Commission recommendations.
EU progress on 2030 targets remains insufficient, with gaps in semiconductors, compute, cybersecurity, skills and AI adoption (20% vs 75% target).
Warns of a public funding shortfall as RRF measures phase out by 2026-2027; links the DDPP to the next MFF and European Competitiveness Fund.
Highlights AI Gigafactories, Cloud and AI Development Act, Chips Act 2.0 and Apply AI Strategy to build technological sovereignty.
Announces a forthcoming review of the Digital Decade Policy Programme later in 2026.
